title: Japan sought a UAP information-sharing agreement with the US

tellings.quote: Japan just begged the United States to enter into a bilateral information sharing agreement with the United States solely for the purposes of sharing UAP information

plain: Japan is said to have pressed the United States for a two-country agreement whose only purpose was sharing information on UAP, the government's term for UFOs. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who says he ran the military's UFO study, makes the claim, saying Japan "begged" for it. If true, it would show that allied governments take the subject seriously enough to seek formal deals over it.
